description: Renovate optionally covers mise.toml, mise version pins and annotated workflow inputs. Inert without the Renovate GitHub App; Dependabot retains the existing package ecosystems.

Runtime manifests and the Home Assistant test baseline remain owner-managed. Coordinated Renovate runtime updates require an explicit migration of both requirements.txt and manifest.json away from the current Dependabot policy.
script/template-sync-guard reads the managers and patterns here to know which pins a template sync must not lower.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Needs Dependabot alerts on in the repository settings. Users only receive a fixed version with a new release.

packageRules.description: Dependabot retains these package ecosystems. Enabling Renovate updates requires an owner-approved migration and matching Dependabot exclusions; the rules below do not enable them.
Keep runtime manifests owner-managed with requirements.txt; do not enable a manifest-only updater while pip requirements remain with Dependabot.
Runtime: what Home Assistant installs for users. One pull request per package; a routine bump stays `chore`, only a security fix is worth a release of its own.
A runtime major waits on the dependency dashboard for a person.
Tooling: everything that runs the checks, CI and the editor moves in one grouped pull request a week; a major update gets one of its own.
A new action version settles a week before it runs with the repository's token, as in Home Assistant Core.
Dependabot retains these actions. Coordinated Renovate updates require an owner decision and matching Dependabot exclusions before this rule is enabled.
Home Assistant decides the Python version. Raise it by hand together with the Home Assistant version.
ShellCheck is the shell linter with no real alternative, so a year without a release is not abandonment.
Renovate's own engines refuse a Node major newer than this.
Raise this pin manually with the supported Home Assistant minimum and test baseline. Dependabot also excludes it; optional Renovate must preserve the same policy.
Scanner updates can arrive outside the weekly schedule after the release age. Checks must pass and the owner merges them manually; automatic merging stays disabled.
